name: CSFalcon_Search
author: Luca Memini
description: Check whether an indicator was observed on CrowdStrike-managed assets and correlate recent alerts in the last X days. Returns device, process and alert context when available.

configurationItems.name: base_url
configurationItems.description: CrowdStrike API Base URL (e.g., https://api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com for EU region)

configurationItems.name: lookback_days
configurationItems.description: How many days back to consider for recent sightings and alert correlation

configurationItems.name: max_results
configurationItems.description: Maximum number of devices/processes/alerts to return

configurationItems.name: include_hidden_alerts
configurationItems.description: Also include hidden alerts during recent alert correlation
